provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: printf receives a variable as its format string.

groundTruth.rationale: Passing a variable as the format lets the caller supply conversion specifiers, which read and write memory (CWE-134).

limitations: Line-level lexical only; data flow into the format argument is not proven.
Variable-as-format is flagged by shape; trusted fixed strings with no conversions never match.
